WARNING: Implementation rules

- The default values of properties should convey the default behavior of a new `--environment` argument (with no back compat issues) and fit the expected behavior of the 90% case of all verbs. This rule is intended to keep verbs always using the same behavior so that verb authors have the little to no custom configuration.
- Name of properties should convey that setting a non-`default` value would be changing the default behavior.
